description: This file defines the 'State' object in the Spark SQL pipelines graph module, including methods for finding and resetting graph elements related to data flow, checkpoints, and table states.

methods.name: findElementsToReset
methods.description: Identifies graph elements to reset based on the current update context and refresh tables.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Performs reset operations on graph elements, including clearing checkpoint data and truncating tables.

methods.name: reset (private)
methods.description: Resets the checkpoint for a specific flow by creating a new checkpoint directory.
